prompt: Append three report episodes with identical addressed headings and distinct report bodies/pointers; poll between appends using private scratch state.
expected_output: Three distinct actionable events, each observed once; unchanged polling and restart emit none.
assertions: unique_events: three fresh heading hashes, no replay on unchanged poll or unrelated growth; a heading completed across polls emits once and body extension stays silent; shrink warns without replay
batch_and_copies: a single poll emits three repeated headings; mirrored copies stay deduplicated; repeated self headings emit only SELF-POST with opt-in
seeded_history: first arm silently seeds repeated history, next matching heading emits one event
legacy_history: legacy heading-only seen hashes and watermark suppress old repeated headings but allow the next one
incomplete_and_boundaries: unclosed fence emits no event or watermark advance, recovery emits once; self, near-miss and code headings remain excluded
follow_smoke: isolated detached producer to packaged follow consumer exposes all three distinct events; real parent attachment remains UNPROVEN
